title: Rama lets Seetha know of King's wish
introduction: Seeing Rama being sad seetha wants to know the reason Rama then lets her know his father's wish and his decision to go to forest. He then askes her to stay in Ayodhya.
closing: || इति श्रि मद्रामयणे अयोध्यकाण्डे षड्विंशः सर्गः ||

verses.devanagari:
अभिवाद्य तु कौसल्याम् रामः सम्प्रस्थितः वनम् |
कृत स्वस्त्ययनो मात्रा धर्मिष्ठे वर्त्मनि स्थितः
विराजयन् राज सुतः राज मार्गम् नरैः वृतम् |
हृदयानि आममन्थ इव जनस्य गुणवत्तया
verses.iast:
abhivādya tu kausalyām rāmaḥ samprasthitaḥ vanam |
kṛta svastyayano mātrā dharmiṣṭhe vartmani sthitaḥ
virājayan rāja sutaḥ rāja mārgam naraiḥ vṛtam |
hṛdayāni āmamantha iva janasya guṇavattayā
verses.translation: The prince Rama, having been invoked blessings by his mother, after having salutation to Kausalya and remaining firmly in his virtuous path, set out journey to the forest. Entering to the road filled with people, he made it shine with his splendour and stirred the hearts of the people because of his excellent qualities.

verses.devanagari:
वैदेही च अपि तत् सर्वम् न शुश्राव तपस्विनी |
तत् एव हृदि तस्याः च यौवराज्य अभिषेचनम्
verses.iast:
vaidehī ca api tat sarvam na śuśrāva tapasvinī |
tat eva hṛdi tasyāḥ ca yauvarājya abhiṣecanam
verses.translation: Sita, practising for the coronation ceremony, did not hear anything on that matter. She was thinking of installation of Rama alone as prince Regent in her heart

glosses.meaning: installation of Rama alone as Prince Regent

verses.devanagari:
देव कार्यम् स्म सा कृत्वा कृतज्ञा हृष्ट चेतना |
अभिज्ञा राज धर्मानाम् राज पुत्रम् प्रतीक्षते
verses.iast:
deva kāryam sma sā kṛtvā kṛtaGYā hṛṣṭa cetanā |
abhiGYā rāja dharmānām rāja putram pratīkṣate
verses.translation: As she knows what is to be done and is aware of rules relating to kings Sita herself being rejoiced in heart, performed the worship of the gods and was waiting for the prince.

glosses.meaning: as she knows what is to be done
and was waiting raajaputram = for the prince

verses.devanagari:
प्रविवेश अथ रामः तु स्व वेश्म सुविभूषितम् |
प्रहृष्ट जन सम्पूर्णम् ह्रिया किंचित् अवान् मुखः
verses.iast:
praviveśa atha rāmaḥ tu sva veśma suvibhūṣitam |
prahṛṣṭa jana sampūrṇam hriyā kiṃcit avān mukhaḥ
verses.translation: Thereafter Rama, slightly turning his face down , entered his own house which is well decorated and is filled with rejoicing people all around

verses.devanagari:
अथ सीता समुत्पत्य वेपमाना च तम् पतिम् |
अपश्यत् शोक सम्तप्तम् चिन्ता व्याकुलिल इन्द्रियम्
verses.iast:
atha sītā samutpatya vepamānā ca tam patim |
apaśyat śoka samtaptam cintā vyākulila indriyam
verses.translation: Sita sprang up from her seat and trembled by seeing her husband stricken with sorrow, his mind perturbed with anxiety.

glosses.meaning: having his mind perturbed with anxiety

verses.devanagari:
ताम् दृष्ट्वा स हि धर्मात्मा न शशाक मनोगतम् |
तम् शोकम् राघवह् सोढुम् ततो विवृतताम् गतः
verses.iast:
tām dṛśhṭvā sa hi dharmātmā na śaśāka manogatam |
tam śokam rāghavah soḍhum tato vivṛtatām gataḥ
verses.translation: By seeing her, Rama the virtuous man could not contain that grief existing in his mind and hence got unveiled.

verses.devanagari:
विवर्ण वदनम् दृष्ट्वा तम् प्रस्विन्नम् अमर्षणम् |
आह दुह्ख अभिसम्तप्ता किम् इदानीम् इदम् प्रभो
verses.iast:
vivarṇa vadanam dṛṣṭvā tam prasvinnam amarṣaṇam |
āha duhkha abhisamtaptā kim idānīm idam prabho
verses.translation: Seeing him pale-faced, perspired and without endurance, Sita (stricken with grief) spoke thus what is this now , my Lord!

verses.devanagari:
अद्य बार्हस्पतः श्रीमान् युक्तः पुष्यो न राघव |
प्रोच्यते ब्राह्मणैः प्राज्ञैः केन त्वम् असि दुर्मनाः
verses.iast:
adya bārhaspataḥ śrīmān yuktaḥ puṣyo na rāghava |
procyate brāhmaṇaiḥ prāGYaiḥ kena tvam asi durmanāḥ
verses.translation: Oh , Rama! It is indeed told by learned brahmanas that today's constellation Pushya (which is presided by sage bR^ihaspati) which is propitions, is suitable (for coronation). Why are you sadly disposed?

verses.devanagari:
न ते शत शलाकेन जल फेन निभेन च |
आवृतम् वदनम् वल्गु चत्रेण अभिविराजते
verses.iast:
na te śata śalākena jala phena nibhena ca |
āvṛtam vadanam valgu catreṇa abhivirājate
verses.translation: Your handsome face does not shine splendidly as it should when covered by an umbrella white as water-froth and provided with a hundred ribs.

verses.devanagari:
व्यजनाभ्याम् च मुख्याभ्याम् शत पत्र निभ ईक्षणम् |
चन्द्र हंस प्रकाशाभ्याम् वीज्यते न तव आननम्
verses.iast:
vyajanābhyām ca mukhyābhyām śata patra nibha īkṣaṇam |
candra haṃsa prakāśābhyām vījyate na tava ānanam
verses.translation: Nor your lotus -eyed face is not being fanned (as it should ) by superior chowries shining like a moon and a swan

glosses.meaning: shining like a moon and a swan.

verses.devanagari:
वाग्मिनो बन्दिनः च अपि प्रहृष्टाः त्वम् नर ऋषभ |
स्तुवन्तः न अद्य दृश्यन्ते मन्गलैः सूत मागधाः
verses.iast:
vāgmino bandinaḥ ca api prahṛṣṭāḥ tvam nara ṛṣabha |
stuvantaḥ na adya dṛśyante mangalaiḥ sūta māgadhāḥ
verses.translation: Nor the overjoyed and eloquent bards Sutas and Maagadhas (who sing portions of epic poems and ancient ballads ) are seen here , praising you with auspicious words .

glosses.meaning: oh the best of men! prahR^ishhTaaH = The overjoyed
Sutas and Magadhas who sing portions of epic poems and ancient ballads

verses.devanagari:
न ते क्षौद्रम् च दधि च ब्राह्मणा वेद पारगाः |
मूर्ध्नि मूर्ध अवसिक्तस्य दधति स्म विधानतः
verses.iast:
na te kṣaudram ca dadhi ca brāhmaṇā veda pāragāḥ |
mūrdhni mūrdha avasiktasya dadhati sma vidhānataḥ
verses.translation: Nor brahmanas who are well-versed in Vedas, have not placed , as per prescribed Rites , honey and curds on your head after you had taken the head -bath

glosses.meaning: who have seen the end of the Vedas
after you had taken a head -bath.

verses.devanagari:
न त्वाम् प्रकृतयः सर्वा श्रेणी मुख्याः च भूषिताः |
अनुव्रजितुम् इच्चन्ति पौर जापपदाः तथा
verses.iast:
na tvām prakṛtayaḥ sarvā śreṇī mukhyāḥ ca bhūṣitāḥ |
anuvrajitum iccanti paura jāpapadāḥ tathā
verses.translation: All ministers, chiefs of Associations, citizens and country-folk, duly decked with ornaments, are not inclined to go along with you.

verses.devanagari:
चतुर्भिर् वेग सम्पन्नैः हयैः कान्चन भूषणैः |
मुख्यः पुष्य रथो युक्तः किम् न गच्चति ते अग्रतः
verses.iast:
caturbhir vega sampannaiḥ hayaiḥ kāncana bhūṣaṇaiḥ |
mukhyaḥ puṣya ratho yuktaḥ kim na gaccati te agrataḥ
verses.translation: Why the main carriage used for travelling and pleasure, tied with four horses decked with gold ornaments and with excellent speed does not go ahead of you ?

glosses.meaning: carriage used for travelling or pleasure

verses.devanagari:
न हस्ती च अग्रतः श्रीमांस् तव लक्षण पूजितः |
प्रयाणे लक्ष्यते वीर कृष्ण मेघ गिरि प्रभः
verses.iast:
na hastī ca agrataḥ śrīmāṃs tava lakṣaṇa pūjitaḥ |
prayāṇe lakṣyate vīra kṛṣṇa megha giri prabhaḥ
verses.translation: Oh, valiant prince! A glorious elephant which is worshipped for its good characteristics, resembling a mountain crowned with a dark cloud is not seen ahead in your journey.

glosses.meaning: which is worshipped for its good characteristics
resembling a mountain crowned with a dark cloud

verses.devanagari:
न च कान्चन चित्रम् ते पश्यामि प्रिय दर्शन |
भद्र आसनम् पुरः कृत्य यान्तम् वीर पुरह्सरम्
verses.iast:
na ca kāncana citram te paśyāmi priya darśana |
bhadra āsanam puraḥ kṛtya yāntam vīra purahsaram
verses.translation: Oh, brave man pleasant with the sight! I do not see marching before you an elephant having been placed in front with an excellent seat embroidered in gold meant for you

glosses.meaning: having been placed in front te = your

verses.devanagari:
अभिषेको यदा सज्जः किम् इदानीम् इदम् तव |
अपूर्वो मुख वर्णः च न प्रहर्षः च लक्ष्यते
verses.iast:
abhiṣeko yadā sajjaḥ kim idānīm idam tava |
apūrvo mukha varṇaḥ ca na praharṣaḥ ca lakṣyate
verses.translation: While coronation is getting ready now, the colour of your face is appearing strange. Even happiness is not being seen (in you). Why is it?

verses.devanagari:
इति इव विलपन्तीम् ताम् प्रोवाच रघु नन्दनः |
सीते तत्रभवांस् तात प्रव्राजयति माम् वनम्
verses.iast:
iti iva vilapantīm tām provāca raghu nandanaḥ |
sīte tatrabhavāṃs tāta pravrājayati mām vanam
verses.translation: Rama spoke thus to Sita, who is lamenting : Oh, Sita! My venerable father is sending me to a forest in exile.

verses.devanagari:
कुले महति सम्भूते धर्मज्ञे धर्म चारिणि |
शृणु जानकि येन इदम् क्रमेण अभ्यागतम् मम
verses.iast:
kule mahati sambhūte dharmaGYe dharma cāriṇi |
śṛṇu jānaki yena idam krameṇa abhyāgatam mama
verses.translation: Oh, Sita ! You are born in a great family. You know what is Right and practise virtue . hear me in what sequence it happened to me

glosses.meaning: one who knows what is R^ight

verses.devanagari:
राज्ञा सत्य प्रतिज्ञेन पित्रा दशरथेन मे |
कैकेय्यै प्रीत मनसा पुरा दत्तौ महा वरौ
verses.iast:
rāGYā satya pratiGYena pitrā daśarathena me |
kaikeyyai prīta manasā purā dattau mahā varau
verses.translation: Two great boons were given to my mother Kaikeyi long ago , by my father Dasaratha who is true to a promise.

glosses.meaning: who is true to a promise.

verses.devanagari:
तया अद्य मम सज्जे अस्मिन्न् अभिषेके नृप उद्यते |
प्रचोदितः स समयो धर्मेण प्रतिनिर्जितः
verses.iast:
tayā adya mama sajje asminn abhiṣeke nṛpa udyate |
pracoditaḥ sa samayo dharmeṇa pratinirjitaḥ
verses.translation: Now that the arrangements initiated by the king for my coronation are getting ready , Kaikeyi came out with that promise of boons, turning the situation to her own advantage by grounds of morality

verses.devanagari:
चतुर्दश हि वर्षाणि वस्तव्यम् दण्डके मया |
पित्रा मे भरतः च अपि यौवराज्ये नियोजितः
verses.iast:
caturdaśa hi varṣāṇi vastavyam daṇḍake mayā |
pitrā me bharataḥ ca api yauvarājye niyojitaḥ
verses.translation: I have to dwell in Dandaka forest for fourteen years .Bharata is being appointed as prince by my father

verses.devanagari:
सो अहम् त्वाम् आगतः द्रष्टुम् प्रस्थितः विजनम् वनम् |
भरतस्य समीपे ते न अहम् कथ्यः कदाचन
ऋद्धि युक्ता हि पुरुषा न सहन्ते पर स्तवम् |
तस्मान् न ते गुणाः कथ्या भरतस्य अग्रतः मम
verses.iast:
so aham tvām āgataḥ draṣṭum prasthitaḥ vijanam vanam |
bharatasya samīpe te na aham kathyaḥ kadācana
ṛddhi yuktā hi puruṣā na sahante para stavam |
tasmān na te guṇāḥ kathyā bharatasya agrataḥ mama
verses.translation: Before setting forth to the lonely forest, I came to see you. I should not be praised at any time in the presence of Bharata . Men endowed with power and fortune indeed do not tolerate praise of others . Therefore, my virtues should not be extolled by you in front of Bharata.

glosses.meaning: shall never to be told about
do not fit to be told

verses.devanagari:
न अपि त्वम् तेन भर्तव्या विशेषेण कदाचन
अनुकूलतया शक्यम् समीपे तस्य वर्तितुम्
verses.iast:
na api tvam tena bhartavyā viśeṣeṇa kadācana
anukūlatayā śakyam samīpe tasya vartitum
verses.translation: You need not be attended in a special manner at any time by him. You can stay familiar to him, by behaving with him conformably.

verses.devanagari:
तस्मै दत्तम् नृवतिना यौवराज्यम् सनातनम् |
स प्रसाद्यस्त्वया सीते नृपतिश्च विशेषतः
verses.iast:
tasmai dattam nṛvatinā yauvarājyam sanātanam |
sa prasādyastvayā sīte nṛpatiśca viśeśhataḥ
verses.translation: The princely kingdom is given to him by the king permanently. Oh, Sita ! He is fit to be rendered gracious by you, more so the king Dasaratha

glosses.meaning: is fit to be rendered gracious

verses.devanagari:
अहम् च अपि प्रतिज्ञाम् ताम् गुरोह् समनुपालयन् |
वनम् अद्य एव यास्यामि स्थिरा भव मनस्विनि
verses.iast:
aham ca api pratiGYām tām guroh samanupālayan |
vanam adya eva yāsyāmi sthirā bhava manasvini
verses.translation: Keeping up the pledge of my father, today itself. Oh, Sita of magnanimous mind! Remain firm.

verses.devanagari:
याते च मयि कल्याणि वनम् मुनि निषेवितम् |
व्रत उपवास रतया भवितव्यम् त्वया अनघे
verses.iast:
yāte ca mayi kalyāṇi vanam muni niṣevitam |
vrata upavāsa ratayā bhavitavyam tvayā anaghe
verses.translation: Oh, Sita the good and faultless lady ! After I leave for the forest frequented by the sages, you can become interested in religious vows and fastings.

glosses.meaning: interested in relegious vows and fastings

verses.devanagari:
काल्यम् उत्थाय देवानाम् कृत्वा पूजाम् यथा विधि |
वन्दितव्यो दशरथः पिता मम नर ईश्वरः
verses.iast:
kālyam utthāya devānām kṛtvā pūjām yathā vidhi |
vanditavyo daśarathaḥ pitā mama nara īśvaraḥ
verses.translation: You can rise up in dawn , perform worship of the deities as per precept and do salutation to my father , king Dasaratha.

verses.devanagari:
माता च मम कौसल्या वृद्धा सम्ताप कर्शिता |
धर्मम् एव अग्रतः कृत्वा त्वत्तः सम्मानम् अर्हति
verses.iast:
mātā ca mama kausalyā vṛddhā samtāpa karśitā |
dharmam eva agrataḥ kṛtvā tvattaḥ sammānam arhati
verses.translation: Keeping in front of righteousness alone, you have to respect the aged Kausalya, my mother who is getting emaciated by grief.

glosses.meaning: who is getting emaciated by grief

verses.devanagari:
वन्दितव्याः च ते नित्यम् याः शेषा मम मातरः |
स्नेह प्रणय सम्भोगैः समा हि मम मातरः
verses.iast:
vanditavyāḥ ca te nityam yāḥ śeṣā mama mātaraḥ |
sneha praṇaya sambhogaiḥ samā hi mama mātaraḥ
verses.translation: For me all my mothers are equal in my eyes in point if fondness, love and the way in which they have looked after me ( in my childhood). Hence the rest of mothers also deserve to be saluted always by you

verses.devanagari:
भ्रातृ पुत्र समौ च अपि द्रष्टव्यौ च विशेषतः |
त्वया लक्ष्मण शत्रुघ्नौ प्राणैः प्रियतरौ मम
verses.iast:
bhrātṛ putra samau ca api draṣṭavyau ca viśeṣataḥ |
tvayā lakṣmaṇa śatrughnau prāṇaiḥ priyatarau mama
verses.translation: You, in particular, should regard Bharata and Satrughna, as your brothers or sons.

glosses.meaning: deserve to be seen = bhraatR^i putrasamau = as brothers or sons.

verses.devanagari:
विप्रियम् न च कर्तव्यम् भरतस्य कदाचन |
स हि राजा प्रभुः चैव देशस्य च कुलस्य च
verses.iast:
vipriyam na ca kartavyam bharatasya kadācana |
sa hi rājā prabhuḥ caiva deśasya ca kulasya ca
verses.translation: Bharata is indeed king and the master both for the kingdom and for our family . Hence, you should not do what is displeasing to him at any time.

verses.devanagari:
आराधिता हि शीलेन प्रयत्नैः च उपसेविताः |
राजानः सम्प्रसीदन्ति प्रकुप्यन्ति विपर्यये
verses.iast:
ārādhitā hi śīlena prayatnaiḥ ca upasevitāḥ |
rājānaḥ samprasīdanti prakupyanti viparyaye
verses.translation: Kings being pleased by good character and served by exerting one's self become happy. They get angry if it is to the contrary

glosses.meaning: if it is to the contrary.

verses.devanagari:
औरसान् अपि पुत्रान् हि त्यजन्ति अहित कारिणः |
समर्थान् सम्प्रगृह्णन्ति जनान् अपि नर अधिपाः
verses.iast:
aurasān api putrān hi tyajanti ahita kāriṇaḥ |
samarthān sampragṛhṇanti janān api nara adhipāḥ
verses.translation: Kings abandon even their own sons, if they are antagonistic and accept even other people if they are fitting

glosses.meaning: abandon aurasaan putraanapi = even their own sons

verses.devanagari:
सा त्वम् वसेह कल्याणि राज्ञः समनुवर्तिनी |
भरतस्य रता धर्मे सत्यव्रतपरायणा
verses.iast:
sā tvam vaseha kalyāṇi rājJṇaḥ samanuvartinī |
bharatasya ratā dharme satyavrataparāyaṇā
verses.translation: Oh good lady ! You such dwell here, doing conformably to the will of Bharata the king, remaining devoted to righteousness and with a vow of truth as you end.

glosses.meaning: You as such samannvartinii = doing conformably to the will
with a vow of truth as the end

verses.devanagari:
अहम् गमिष्यामि महा वनम् प्रिये |
त्वया हि वस्तव्यम् इह एव भामिनि |
यथा व्यलीकम् कुरुषे न कस्यचित् |
तथा त्वया कार्यम् इदम् वचो मम
verses.iast:
aham gamiṣyāmi mahā vanam priye |
tvayā hi vastavyam iha eva bhāmini |
yathā vyalīkam kuruṣe na kasyacit |
tathā tvayā kāryam idam vaco mama
verses.translation: Oh, my dear Sita ! I can go to the great forest. You can stay here only, without doing harm to any one as it is .Listen to my words

glosses.meaning: my dear ! aham = I gamishhyaami = can go
